title: Counting up to 100: Counting On and Back, 1 More and 1 Less
seo_title: Grade 1 Counting to 100 Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Count up to 100 (includes counting up or down from a given number and identifying a number that is 1 more or 1 less than a given number).
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 counting worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: count objects, count on and back, 1 more and 1 less, and the hundred chart up to 100. 100 questions with pictures and answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Touch each object once and say one number for each.
  • To count on, start at a number and keep going: 46, 47, 48.
  • To count back, go the other way: 52, 51, 50.
  • 1 more is the next number. 1 less is the number before. After 79 comes 80.

Examples

Example

1 more than 59

59, 60

Answer: 60

Example

1 less than 40

40, 39

Answer: 39

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting twiceTouch each object once.
Wrong way backCounting back, numbers get smaller.
After 79After 79 comes 80, not 70.

faq.q: What does MATATAG Math 1 ask about counting?
faq.a: Count up to 100, including counting up or down from a given number and identifying a number that is 1 more or 1 less.

faq.q: How can I practice counting at home?
faq.a: Count stairs, beans or coins together.

items.q: How many apples?
items.e: Touch each one once: 1, 2, 3, 4. There are 4 apples.
Touch each one once. The first 5, then count on: 6, 7. There are 7 stars.

items.q: How many balls?
items.e: Touch each one once. The first 5, then count on: 6, 7, 8, 9. There are 9 balls.
Touch each one once. The first 5, then count on: 6, 7, 8, 9, 10. There are 10 buttons.

items.q: Count on: 14, 15, 16, ☐. What comes next?

items.q: Count on: 23, 24, 25, ☐. What comes next?

items.q: Count on: 28, ☐, 30. What number is missing?
items.e: The missing number comes after 28 and before 30. After 28 comes 29.

items.q: Count back: 86, 85, 84, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Counting back, each number is 1 less. 84 − 1 = 83.
